# Fix solve for odd heights: separator row is all 5s; find by content.
def k_of(inp):
    return [i for i,r in enumerate(inp) if all(x==5 for x in r)][0]
def solve(inp):
    k=k_of(inp)
    top=inp[:k]; bot=inp[k+1:]
    gaps={c:(sum(r.count(c) for r in top)-sum(r.count(c) for r in bot)) for c in (2,4)}
    mx=max(gaps.values())
    winners=[c for c,g in gaps.items() if g==mx]
    out=[[min(winners)]*2 for _ in range(2)]
    return out
